title: JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models
title_zh: JANUS：通过协同进化的世界模型增强长期自主研究

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon autonomous research has shown promise in accelerating scientific progress through sustained cycles of hypothesis generation, implementation, and validation. However, this Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm relies on reactive trial-and-error, where costly and time-consuming executions introduce severe feedback delays, throttling evolutionary progress under explosively expanding search space. To address this challenge, we propose JANUS, a framework that unifies future outcomes forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Within an evolving graph, the research agent proposes candidates while world model scores them by forecasting value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility, then accordingly selects, refines, or prunes branches prior to execution. After receiving ground-truth feedback, JANUS distills experiences into evolving skills: hierarchical skills for research agent, exploration-strategy skills for world model, and their coordination protocols. This mechanism enables continual co-evolution: the research agent sharpens candidate generation while the world model refines its predictive judgment over extended horizons. Extensive evaluations on MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks demonstrate that JANUS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving both higher evolving efficiency and ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 长期自主研究已展现出通过持续进行假设生成、实施与验证的循环来加速科学进步的潜力。 然而，这种“生成-执行-反馈”范式依赖反应式的试错方法，其中代价高昂且耗时漫长的执行过程会引入严重的反馈延迟，从而在搜索空间爆炸式扩张的情况下抑制进化进展。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 JANUS——一个通过由协同进化的世界模型驱动的“预测-验证-进化”循环，将未来结果预测与过往经验反思相统一的框架。 在一个不断演化的图中，研究智能体提出候选方案，而世界模型则通过预测价值提升、信息增益和探索效用对其进行评分，并据此在执行前选择、优化或剪枝分支。 在获得真实反馈后，JANUS 将经验提炼为可进化的技能：包括研究智能体的分层技能、世界模型的探索策略技能，以及二者之间的协调协议。 这种机制支持持续的协同进化：研究智能体不断精进候选方案生成能力，而世界模型则在更长的时间跨度内优化其预测判断。 在 MLS-Bench-Lite 和真实研究任务上的广泛评估表明，JANUS 显著优于当前最先进的基线方法，实现了更高的进化效率与上限。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous research (AutoResearch) ( Karpathy, 2026 ; Gaddipati et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) operationalizes fully automated, end-to-end scientific discovery ( Team, 2026 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) through an iterative loop, wherein agents generate candidate solutions, evaluate outcomes, incorporate execution feedback, and use accumulated evidence to guide subsequent iterations. Such discovery loops have driven substantial progress across diverse domains, including algorithm design ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) , automated model training ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2026 ) , open-ended scientific problem solving ( Georgiev et al., 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) , and systems design ( Jaber and Jaber, 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自主研究（AutoResearch）（Karpathy，2026；Gaddipati 等，2026；Qian 等，2026；Liu 等，2026b）通过一个迭代循环将完全自动化、端到端的科学发现（Team，2026；Novikov 等，2025）具体化：智能体在此循环中生成候选解决方案、评估结果、整合执行反馈，并利用积累的证据指导后续迭代。 此类发现循环已在多个不同领域推动了重大进展，包括算法设计（Novikov 等，2025；Romera-Paredes 等，2024）、自动化模型训练（Jiang 等，2025；Nam 等，2026）、开放式的科学问题求解（Georgiev 等，2025；Anthropic，2026）以及系统设计（Jaber 和 Jaber，2026；Cao 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Recent AutoResearch frameworks have made significant progress by leveraging agentic workflows ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Team, 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) or execution-driven heuristic search ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) . These frameworks typically follow a “Generate-Execute-Feedback” loop, wherein the system iteratively refines code based on runtime output ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . However, this paradigm suffers from a severe execution bottleneck , as physical execution is computationally expensive and time-consuming, often requiring hours of model training, simulation, and compilation. Such expensive trial-and-error is severely magnified under expansive search spaces : as ongoing experiments continually spawn new hypotheses, the space of possible research trajectories branches combinatorially over time.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 AutoResearch 框架通过利用智能体工作流程（Tang 等，2026；Team，2026；Liu 等，2026a；Yang 等，2026）或执行驱动的启发式搜索（Jiang 等，2025；Chen 等，2026；Jin 等，2026），取得了显著进展。 这些框架通常遵循“生成-执行-反馈”循环，系统会根据运行时输出迭代优化代码（Yao 等，2023）。 然而，这种范式存在严重的执行瓶颈，因为物理执行在计算上既昂贵又耗时，通常需要数小时进行模型训练、模拟和编译。 在庞大的搜索空间中，这种代价高昂的试错过程会被严重放大：随着持续实验不断产生新的假设，可能的研究路径空间会随时间呈组合式分支扩展。

paragraphs.en: Fundamentally, overcoming this bottleneck requires going beyond the incremental gains in conventional iterative refinement. Instead, the core objective of AutoResearch poses a scaling problem: as research compute expands, how should a system navigate long-horizon exploration to maximize cumulative progress? We formalize this relationship between research budget and achievable progress as the evolving scaling law of autonomous research. A desirable research system should improve both its evolving efficiency —how rapidly progress accumulates—and its evolving ceiling —how far continued exploration advances. To achieve the desired scaling behavior in AutoResearch, we advocate for a paradigm shift from reactive trial-and-error to metacognitive exploration : (i) proactively forecasting outcomes before physical execution, (ii) adaptively allocating execution resources during search, and (iii) systematically turning past experiences into reusable research intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 从根本上说，要克服这一瓶颈，就必须超越传统迭代优化所带来的渐进式进步。 相反，AutoResearch 的核心目标提出了一个扩展性问题：随着研究计算能力的扩展，系统应如何规划长期探索，以实现累计进展的最大化？ 我们将研究预算与可实现进展之间的关系形式化为自主研究的动态扩展定律。 一个理想的研究系统应当同时提升其动态效率——即进展积累的速度——以及其动态上限——即持续探索所能达到的深度。 为了在 AutoResearch 中实现理想的扩展行为，我们主张从被动的试错方法转向元认知探索：（i）在实际执行前主动预测结果，（ii）在搜索过程中自适应地分配执行资源，以及（iii）系统地将过往经验转化为可复用的研究直觉。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose JANUS 1 1 1 In Roman mythology, JANUS is the two-faced god who looks simultaneously toward the future and the past. Similarly, our framework embodies this duality: one face looks forward as a world model to forecast experimental outcomes prior to execution, while the other looks backward to assimilate ground-truth feedback, driving the co-evolution of the research agent, the world model and their coordination. , a framework that unifies future outcome forecasting and past experience reflection through a “Predict-Verify-Evolve” loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Specifically, we formalize an evolving research graph to serve as the unifying foundation, enabling dynamic branch exploration, structured experience management, and topology-aware performance attribution. Within this graph, JANUS first forecasts before acting : the orchestrator generates candidate proposals to expand the graph, while the world model evaluates them via an adaptive exploration strategy balancing value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility—then selecting, refining, or pruning branches prior to execution. Upon receiving execution feedback, JANUS then reflects on experience , distilling raw execution logs into hierarchical and role-specific evolving skills. This closed-loop process drives the continual co-evolution of the research agent, the world model, and their coordination protocols, empowering the system to continuously learn and evolve while transcending myopic trial-and-error across complex, non-monotonic research spaces.

paragraphs.en: Empirically, we comprehensively evaluate JANUS across MLS-Bench-Lite Lyu et al. (2026a) and real-world research tasks covering algorithm optimization, system design, and scientific discovery. We demonstrate that JANUS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, consistently generating valid and competitive solutions across various backbone models. We further trace its evolving scaling laws , showing that JANUS achieves superior evolving efficiency with lower compute budgets and a higher evolving ceiling before plateauing. Ablation studies further validate the superiority of both the adaptive exploration strategy and experience-driven co-evolution.

paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 JANUS，一个通过由协同进化的世界模型驱动的“预测-验证-演进”循环，将未来结果预测与过往经验反思统一起来的框架。

paragraphs.en: We introduce an evolving research graph, upon which we design a world-model-guided adaptive exploration strategy to navigate research toward superior trajectories and an experience-driven co-evolution mechanism for the research agent, world model, and their coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种不断演化的研究图，并基于此设计了一种由世界模型引导的自适应探索策略，以引导研究走向更优的发展路径；同时，我们还为研究智能体、世界模型及其协同作用引入了一种以经验驱动的共同演化机制。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that JANUS achieves state-of-the-art performance across MLS-Bench-Lite and real-world research tasks, exhibiting superior evolving efficiency and a higher evolving ceiling as additional search compute is invested.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，JANUS 在 MLS-Bench-Lite 和真实世界研究任务中均实现了当前最先进的性能，并展现出卓越的演化效率以及更高的演化上限——随着搜索计算资源的投入增加，其优势愈发显著。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems decompose research across agents with complementary responsibilities. Early systems use specialized roles to structure research Schmidgall et al. (2025) ; Tang et al. (2026) , while R&D-Agent Yang et al. (2025) couples researcher and developer agents through experimental feedback. Recent systems further introduce persistent memory and self-evolution Lyu et al. (2026b) , or adversarial executor–reviewer collaboration for reliable scientific reasoning Yang et al. (2026) . Arbor Jin et al. (2026) instead uses a hypothesis tree coordinated by a long-lived agent and executed by short-lived agents. However these systems still face challenges in efficient information exchange and role-specific experience utilization. Janus addresses this through a shared evolving research graph and an experience-driven co-evolution mechanism.

paragraphs.en: Recent work suggests that LLMs can function as implicit or explicit world models for planning and decision making. RAP Hao et al. (2023) frames reasoning as planning with an LLM world model, while complementary approaches induce structured domain models (e.g., PDDL) from language for classical planning Guan et al. (2023) . Gkountouras et al. (2025) integrate LLM agents with causal world models that explicitly capture environment dynamics. Recent works Gu et al. (2024) ; Fang et al. (2025) ; Chae et al. (2025) ; Shen et al. (2026) further use LLM-based world models to simulate action outcomes and evaluate candidate trajectories for agentic planning. Most existing approaches target relatively fixed tasks and do not continually update the world model. Janus instead enables the world model to evolve with the research process, allowing its ability to improve over time.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究指出，大型语言模型（LLM）可以作为隐式或显式的世界模型，用于规划与决策。RAP Hao 等人 （2023）将推理框架为基于 LLM 世界模型的规划，而互补方法则从语言中推导出结构化的领域模型（例如 PDDL），以支持经典规划 Guan 等人（2023）。Gkountouras 等人 （2025）将 LLM 智能体与能够显式捕捉环境动态的因果世界模型相整合。近期研究 Gu 等人（2024）；Fang 等人（2025）；Chae 等人（2025）；Shen 等人 （2026）进一步利用基于 LLM 的世界模型来模拟行动结果，并评估候选轨迹，以实现智能体规划。 大多数现有方法针对相对固定的任务，并不会持续更新世界模型。 相比之下，Janus 使世界模型能够随着研究过程而演进，从而使其能力随时间推移不断提升。

paragraphs.en: The core challenge in open-ended research lies in balancing immediate gains against long-term exploration. JANUS leverages its world model to evaluate these complementary value drivers, dynamically adjusting their weights based on recent progress and remaining budget. These priorities govern proposal refinement and selection, steering research exploration trajectory across iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 开放式研究中的核心挑战在于平衡即时收益与长期探索。 JANUS 利用其世界模型来评估这些互补的价值驱动因素，并根据近期进展和剩余预算动态调整它们的权重。 这些优先级决定了提案的优化与选择，从而引导研究探索在不同迭代中的发展轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We report six metrics on MLS-Bench-Lite. Valid Sub. measures the percentage of tasks whose final submissions successfully complete evaluation and pass validity checks. Beat Any , Beat Median , and Beat All measure the percentages of tasks that outperform at least one, the median-performing, and all human baselines, respectively. Dev Score and Test Score report the mean normalized task scores under the development and test evaluation settings. For the three real research tasks, we report validation bits per byte (Val. BPB) for nanoGPT, speedup over PyTorch eager execution (Speedup) for MinGPT Causal Attention, and macro-averaged Pearson correlation (Macro r r ) for genotype-to-phenotype prediction. Detailed metric definitions are provided in Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate JANUS on MLS-Bench-Lite under controlled protocol, with the primary results reported in Table 1 . We highlight the following: (1) JANUS outperforms all baselines across six evaluation metrics, demonstrating the superior efficacy of our Predict-Verify-Evolve loop in systematically driving meaningful progress. (2) JANUS achieves 100.0% valid improvements upon its weakest human baseline and surpasses all provided human baselines on 43.3% of tasks, establishing a level of performance that directly rivals human expert standards. (3) JANUS demonstrates robust backbone generality, consistently maintaining its performance advantage across different base model backbones. Moreover, its modular architecture is fully compatible with existing harnesses; when integrating our loop with Codex, the framework achieves a peak score of 49.78.

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate JANUS on three real end-to-end research tasks: nanoGPT training optimization, MinGPT Attention Kernel Optimization, and genotype-to-phenotype (G2P) prediction. Figure 3 traces the best-so-far performance, while Table 2 quantifies sample-efficiency speedups. Together, they reveal three key insights. (1) Consistent cross-task dominance. JANUS leads the best-so-far curves through most of the research process across all three tasks, while the strongest baseline varies. (2) Faster progress per experiment. paragraphs.en: We further analyze the roles of the world model and co-evolution. Here, w/o World Model removes the world model together with the evolution mechanism, while w/o “component(s)” Evolve disables reflection and skill summarization for them. (3) Their effects are also qualitatively different: without world-model evolution, progress is more likely to stall during plateaus, whereas without research-agent evolution, improvement becomes slower throughout the research process. paragraphs.en: We analyze how the research strategy evolves throughout the nanoGPT research process. We use GPT-5.6 Sol to score each proposal along three dimensions—exploitation, information gain, and exploration (details shown in Appendix H ). Figure 6 (c) shows four patterns. (1) Exploration is emphasized early, while exploitation gradually increases as promising directions emerge. (2) When performance plateaus, exploration rises and exploitation declines, followed by improvement in best-so-far performance. (3) Increases in information gain are followed by major performance breakthroughs, indicating that resolving uncertainty helps drive subsequent progress. (4) As the remaining budget decreases, exploitation increases while exploration declines. Together, these patterns show a dynamic research strategy throughout the research progress.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了研究策略在整个 nanoGPT 研究过程中的演变方式。 我们使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 从三个维度对每个提案进行评分——利用、信息增益和探索（详见附录 H）。 图 6(c) 展示了四种模式。 (1) 早期强调探索，而随着有前景的方向逐渐显现，利用程度逐步提高。 (2) 当性能达到平台期时，探索程度上升而利用程度下降，随后最佳迄今性能得到提升。 (3) 信息增益的增加之后会伴随重大的性能突破，这表明解决不确定性有助于推动后续进展。 (4) 随着剩余预算的减少，利用程度增加而探索程度下降。 这些模式共同揭示了整个研究过程中动态变化的研究策略。

paragraphs.en: We present JANUS, a framework for long-horizon autonomous research that unifies future outcome forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop. Over an evolving research graph, the world model guides proposal refinement and selection by balancing value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility. JANUS distills experimental feedback into research agent, world-model, and coordination skills, driving system-wide co-evolution. Evaluations on MLS-Bench-Lite and three real-world research tasks demonstrate that JANUS outperforms strong baselines, achieving greater evolving efficiency and a higher evolving ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 JANUS，一个用于长期自主研究的框架，它通过“预测-验证-演进”循环将未来结果预测与过往经验反思统一起来。 在一个不断演化的研究图中，世界模型通过平衡价值提升、信息增益和探索效用来指导提案的优化与选择。 JANUS 将实验反馈提炼为研究智能体、世界模型和协调技能，从而推动整个系统的协同演进。 在 MLS-Bench-Lite 和三个真实世界研究任务上的评估表明，JANUS 的表现优于多个强基线方法，实现了更高的演化效率和更优的演化上限。

paragraphs.en: For nanoGPT training optimization , adapted from AutoResearch Karpathy (2026) , the agent improves a compact single-GPU GPT pretraining system. The editable file contains the model architecture, attention and MLP blocks, optimizer construction, learning-rate schedules, batching strategy, and training loop, while the data preparation, tokenizer, validation split, and metric implementation remain fixed. Training uses a BPE-tokenized text corpus and is evaluated on a pinned validation shard. The objective is to obtain the lowest validation bits per byte (BPB) within a fixed training-time budget. BPB measures the negative log-likelihood assigned to the validation text per byte rather than per token, making comparisons less sensitive to tokenization and vocabulary size.

paragraphs.en: For MinGPT Causal Attention optimization , we use KernelBench Level 3, Task 43 Ouyang et al. (2025) . The reference operator is a complete MinGPT masked multi-head self-attention layer. It applies a joint linear projection to construct queries, keys, and values, reshapes them into attention heads, computes scaled query–key products, applies a lower-triangular causal mask and softmax, aggregates the values, and finally applies an output projection. The agent must implement a drop-in ModelNew with the same constructor and forward semantics. Candidate implementations may replace the PyTorch computation with fused PyTorch operators, compilation strategies, Triton kernels, or custom CUDA code, but must preserve the numerical output. The objective is to maximize execution speedup over the PyTorch eager reference after passing all correctness checks.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 MinGPT 因果注意力优化，我们使用 KernelBench Level 3、Task 43（Ouyang 等人，2025）。 参考算子是一个完整的 MinGPT 掩码多头自注意力层。 它通过联合线性投影构建查询、键和值，将其重塑为注意力头，计算缩放后的查询-键乘积，应用下三角因果掩码和 softmax，聚合值，最后应用输出投影。 智能体必须实现一个可无缝替换的 ModelNew，其构造函数和前向语义需保持一致。 候选实现可以用融合 PyTorch 算子、编译策略、Triton 内核或自定义 CUDA 代码替代 PyTorch 的计算，但必须保留数值输出的一致性。 目标是在通过所有正确性检查后，尽可能提高相对于 PyTorch eager 参考实现的执行速度。

paragraphs.en: For genotype-to-phenotype (G2P) prediction , the input for a maize hybrid consists of its SNP dosage sequence together with the environmental conditions under which it is grown. The benchmark contains 4,269 hybrids, 7,577 MAF/LD-pruned SNP markers, and 185 site–year environments. Environmental inputs are daily time series describing factors such as mean, maximum, and minimum temperature, dew-point temperature, solar and photosynthetically active radiation, precipitation, evapotranspiration, humidity, soil wetness, frost, wind speed, and vapor-pressure deficit. A prediction is made for each hybrid–environment pair, allowing the model to capture genetic effects, environmental effects, and genotype–environment interactions.

paragraphs.en: Each task instantiates a community-recognized research question as an executable problem. An agent receives a task description, a controlled code scaffold, strong reproduced baselines, designated editable regions, and an evaluation interface. Training protocols and evaluators are protected, and tasks involving model components additionally impose capacity constraints. A submission is evaluated over multiple datasets, environments, model scales, or random seeds, rather than on a single development instance. The benchmark therefore measures whether an agent can produce an improvement in the targeted algorithmic component that remains effective across the prescribed evaluation settings.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都将一个社区公认的研究问题具体化为一个可执行的问题。 智能体会收到任务描述、受控的代码框架、可靠的复现基线模型、指定的可编辑区域以及一个评估界面。 训练协议和评估器受到保护，而涉及模型组件的任务还会额外施加容量限制。 提交结果将在多个数据集、环境、模型规模或随机种子上进行评估，而非仅基于单个开发实例。 因此，该基准测试旨在衡量智能体是否能够在目标算法组件上实现改进，且这种改进在规定的评估设置中仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Each agent is given a 5-hour wall-clock research budget per task. Since our experiments use A100 GPUs, we relax the default per-task evaluator timeouts to accommodate hardware-dependent differences in execution speed relative to the H100 setup reported in MLS-Bench Lyu et al. (2026a) . This adjustment allows the prescribed evaluation workloads to complete without premature termination caused by slower execution on our hardware. The same timeout policy is applied to all compared methods, while the agent’s research budget remains unchanged. Under the fixed wall-clock budget, the world model can select top-ranked proposals for parallel execution on the allocated GPU when computational resources permit, improving the utilization of the available research time. To further ensure comparability across methods and backbones, we predefine and hold fixed a common validation split for each task, rather than allowing individual agents to construct their own splits, so that differences in validation performance more directly reflect their ability to optimize under the same feedback.

paragraphs.en: For the MinGPT Causal Attention optimization task from KernelBench Level 3, Task 43, the official workload uses a batch size B B of 128, a sequence length T T of 512, and an embedding dimension C C of 768. Only solution.py may be modified, and it must expose a top-level ModelNew class compatible with the reference constructor.

paragraphs.en: The genotype-to-phenotype (G2P) prediction evaluator exposes a phenotype-independent genotype matrix containing 7,577 single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) dosages per hybrid and two fixed representations of each environment: a basic statistical summary and a richer temporal summary of the daily weather sequence. paragraphs.en: We characterize each proposal along three non-exclusive dimensions. Exploitation measures how strongly it builds on previously supported mechanisms to pursue immediate improvement, such as refining a promising configuration or combining effective modifications. Information gain measures its emphasis on reducing uncertainty about which proposal or research direction should be pursued next, through controlled comparisons, replication, or mechanism isolation. Exploration measures its emphasis on investigating unverified mechanisms or alternative approaches that may open promising directions for subsequent research. The resulting scores are denoted by X t , I t , E t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] X_{t},I_{t},E_{t}\in[0,1] . They need not sum to one, since a proposal can pursue several objectives simultaneously.
